game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected scrolls into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the royal vault.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: In Mill Stream, repeat each round: Drag collected scrolls into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the royal vault. Each round, thieves strike the royal vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the royal vault from thieves in Mill Stream: keep the crate_b meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: crate_b drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 6 (applied tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while crate_b > 0.
